rng: SeedSequence(training_seed).spawn(2): environment child generates one uint64 seed; exploration uses second child. Random uses SeedSequence([314159, scenario_seed]).
boundary_limitation: Relative observations alias wall clipping and target reflection; approximate aggregation, not an exact Markov state. No tabular optimality or convergence claim.

metrics.distance: Post-motion ticks 1..300; pooled integer histogram p95; exclude initial frame.
metrics.acquisition: First post-motion d<=1; otherwise cap300 and acquired=false.
metrics.boundary: Pre-action either object within3 cells of any wall; also target/crosshair slices with denominators.
metrics.recovery: V2 overlapping event windows; last20ticks censored; failures capped20, not successful recoveries.
metrics.ties: Exact float32 equality primary; separately absolute tolerance1e-6 near ties.
metrics.coverage: uint32 state-action update counts; row sums are genuine update counts. Aggregated relative and absolute physical-state coverage are not equivalent.
